Name: Active Window Controls
Author: Harbor
Description: Double-click the active app title in the Dock to maximize it. Right-click for window actions.
Instructions:
Install and make sure the Active window piece is enabled in Dock controls.
Double-click the active app title in the top Dock to maximize or restore its window.
Right-click that title for minimize, close, always-on-top, and app-specific plugin actions.

Name: Always on Top
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep chosen apps above other windows, even while you work in another app.
Instructions:
Install, then enter the apps that should stay above other windows. The default example matches notepad.exe.
Use one executable name per line, such as Discord.exe. Optional title patterns narrow the match.
Click Apply settings and open a matching app. Pause or uninstall the plugin to restore normal stacking.

Options.Label: Apps, one pattern per line (* matches any text)
Excluded apps or titles, one pattern per line

Name: App Collection
Author: Harbor
Description: Make a desktop group of app, folder, and website shortcuts.
Instructions:
Install to add a desktop group of shortcuts.
In Shortcuts, use one Label | path per line. Example: Calculator | calc.exe or Website | https://example.com.
Click Apply settings. Click a named button in the widget to open its app, folder, or website.

Name: App Placement
Author: Harbor
Description: Choose where an app opens: a monitor, side, corner, or the center of the screen.
Instructions:
Install and choose which executable names to match in Apps.
Choose a monitor and screen region. Center width/height are percentages; Edge gap is in pixels.
Click Apply settings, then open a matching app. Placement is applied once for that window. Use Undo layout to restore its previous position.

Options.Label: Apps, one pattern per line (* matches any text)
Excluded apps or titles, one pattern per line

Name: App Volume on the Dock
Author: Harbor
Description: Hold Alt and scroll over a taskbar app to change only that app’s volume.
Instructions:
Install, then play audio in the app you want to adjust.
Activate the bottom taskbar if it is faded. Hold Alt and scroll over that app's icon.
Only that app's active audio sessions change. Volume step percent controls the amount per scroll notch.

Name: Checklist
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep a desktop checklist. Checked tasks stay checked when Harbor restarts.
Instructions:
Install to put a checklist on the desktop.
In Tasks, enter one task per line, then click Apply settings.
Click a checkbox to complete a task. Your checked items are kept when Harbor restarts.

Options.Label: Tasks, one per line
Options.Default:
Make something useful
Take a break

Name: Clipboard Shelf
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep recently copied text nearby. Click an item to copy it again. History clears when Harbor closes.
Instructions:
Install to add Clipboard Shelf to the desktop.
Copy some text in another app. It appears as a new item in the shelf.
Click an older item to copy it again, then paste it where needed. History stays in memory and clears when Harbor exits.

Name: Day Planner
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep your tasks, focus timer, and notes together. Change the layout in the builder.
Instructions:
Install to put your checklist, focus timer, and notes together on the desktop.
Check off tasks, start a focus session, and type directly into the notes area.
Use the visual builder to rearrange sections and adjust their sizes.

Values.items:
Most important task
Take a break

Name: Desk Calculator
Author: Harbor
Description: Type a calculation and see the answer immediately. Parentheses work too.
Instructions:
Install to add the calculator to your desktop.
Type a calculation such as (12 + 8) * 4 in its input. The result updates as you type.
Use +, -, *, /, decimals, and parentheses. Replace the input to start another calculation.

Name: Desktop Clock
Author: Harbor
Description: Put a clock and date on your desktop. Choose their size and format.
Instructions:
Install to place a clock on your desktop. Use Win + D to see it behind your apps.
Drag the widget header to move it. In settings, HH:mm means 24-hour time; h:mm tt means 12-hour time.
Choose a separate Date format, then click Apply settings.

Name: Dock App Labels
Author: Harbor
Description: Show app names or window titles next to taskbar icons. Choose how wide labels can be.
Instructions:
Install to show readable text beside bottom-taskbar app icons.
Choose app names or window titles, and whether labels show always or only for running apps.
Set Maximum label width in pixels, then click Apply settings.

Name: Drive Space
Author: Harbor
Description: See how much space is free on each drive you choose.
Instructions:
Install to show free space for your chosen drives on the desktop.
Enter drive letters separated by commas, for example C:,D:. Only available drives are shown.
Click Apply settings. This panel reports space; it does not clean or delete files.

Name: Ember
Author: Harbor
Description: A warm dark theme with peach accents. Every color is editable.
Instructions:
Click Install to apply this palette to Harbor's Dock, taskbar, widgets, and windows.
Change individual colors below; use a hex color such as #8AB4FF, then click Apply settings.
Pause or uninstall the theme to return to your base appearance. Your saved theme settings are kept.

Name: Focus Timer
Author: Harbor
Description: Start a work timer. Pause, reset, or get a notification when time is up.
Instructions:
Install to add a countdown timer to your desktop.
Set Timer length in minutes, click Apply settings, then press Start on the widget.
Pause holds your remaining time. Reset returns to the full session. Harbor adds a notification when it finishes.

Name: Forest
Author: Harbor
Description: A dark green theme with soft mint accents. Every color is editable.
Instructions:
Click Install to apply this palette to Harbor's Dock, taskbar, widgets, and windows.
Change individual colors below; use a hex color such as #8AB4FF, then click Apply settings.
Pause or uninstall the theme to return to your base appearance. Your saved theme settings are kept.

Name: Middle Click to Close
Author: Harbor
Description: Middle-click a taskbar app to close one of its windows. Save prompts still appear.
Instructions:
Install to change middle-click behavior on the bottom taskbar.
Activate the taskbar if it is faded, then press the mouse wheel over an app icon to close one window.
If the app has unsaved work, its own save prompt still appears. Pause the plugin to restore the usual middle-click action.

Name: Midnight
Author: Harbor
Description: A deep blue theme. Change any color to suit your desktop.
Instructions:
Click Install to apply this palette to Harbor's Dock, taskbar, widgets, and windows.
Change individual colors below; use a hex color such as #8AB4FF, then click Apply settings.
Pause or uninstall the theme to return to your base appearance. Your saved theme settings are kept.

Name: Monitor-specific Dock
Author: Harbor
Description: Each taskbar shows running indicators and window menus for its own display.
Instructions:
Install on a setup with two or more monitors.
Each taskbar's running dots and window menu now refer to windows on that display.
Pinned shortcuts remain available. An app open only on another display can open another instance when clicked here.

Name: Network Meter
Author: Harbor
Description: See how fast files are downloading and uploading right now.
Instructions:
Install to show a network panel on your desktop.
Start a download to see the download rate rise. Upload and download are shown separately.
Drag the panel by its header and change its width in settings.

Name: Plum
Author: Harbor
Description: A dark purple theme with lilac accents. Every color is editable.
Instructions:
Click Install to apply this palette to Harbor's Dock, taskbar, widgets, and windows.
Change individual colors below; use a hex color such as #8AB4FF, then click Apply settings.
Pause or uninstall the theme to return to your base appearance. Your saved theme settings are kept.

Name: Quick Folders
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep your favorite folders one click away. They open in Harbor Files.
Instructions:
Install to add folder shortcuts to the desktop.
In Folders, enter one folder path per line. %USERPROFILE%\Downloads opens your Downloads folder.
Click Apply settings, then click a shortcut in the widget to open it in Harbor Files.

Name: Quick Notes
Author: Harbor
Description: Write a quick note on your desktop. Your text saves as you type.
Instructions:
Install and find Quick Notes on your desktop.
Click inside the note and type. Changes save automatically on this PC.
Set Note title to rename the panel. Drag the header to move it.

Name: Remember Window Positions
Author: Harbor
Description: Remember where you put an app. Reopening it restores that position. Games are skipped.
Instructions:
Install and enter the apps whose window positions should be remembered.
Click Apply settings, open a matching app, and move or resize its ordinary window.
Close and reopen that app to restore the remembered position. Active games are skipped.

Excluded apps or titles, one pattern per line

Name: Resource Desk
Author: Harbor
Description: See CPU, RAM, drive space, and uptime together in one panel.
Instructions:
Install to place CPU, RAM, drive space, and uptime in one desktop panel.
Read the meters while your apps run. Each section uses live system readings.
Use the visual builder to resize, rearrange, or remove sections.

Name: Scroll the Bar for Volume
Author: Harbor
Description: Scroll on the top Dock to change system volume. You can require Alt to avoid accidental changes.
Instructions:
Install, then scroll on the top Dock to change system volume.
Set Require Alt to yes if you want the shortcut to work only while Alt is held.
Change Volume step percent and click Apply settings to choose the amount per notch.

Name: Scroll to Switch Windows
Author: Harbor
Description: Scroll over a taskbar app to switch between its open windows.
Instructions:
Install, then open two or more windows of the same app.
Activate the taskbar with a right-click if it is faded, then scroll over that app's icon to switch windows.
Choose whether minimized windows join the cycle and which scroll direction to use.

Name: Sound Desk
Author: Harbor
Description: Adjust volume, mute audio, and control music from one desktop panel.
Instructions:
Install to add the Sound Desk panel to your desktop.
Use its volume, mute, previous, play/pause, and next buttons to control system audio and media.
Open the visual builder to rearrange the controls or change the panel layout.

Name: Stopwatch
Author: Harbor
Description: Time an activity from zero. Pause or reset whenever you need.
Instructions:
Install, then find Stopwatch on the desktop.
Press Start to count upward from zero; press Pause to hold the reading.
Press Reset to return to zero. Drag the header to keep it within reach.

Name: System Monitor
Author: Harbor
Description: Watch CPU and memory usage. The graph shows recent CPU activity.
Instructions:
Install, then look on your desktop for the CPU and RAM panel.
The CPU line updates while apps work; RAM shows the amount of memory currently in use.
Change History in seconds to show a shorter or longer graph. Click Apply settings.

Name: Toolbar Clock Format
Author: Harbor
Description: Choose the date and time format shown in the top Dock. Add seconds if you want.
Instructions:
Install to show seconds in the top Dock's Time piece.
Date and Time are separate pieces. Right-click either and choose Edit piece for its own format and time zone.
For a combined Clock piece, this plugin's format controls both date and time. Example: ddd, MMM d HH:mm:ss. Click Apply settings.

Name: Unit Converter
Author: Harbor
Description: Convert temperatures, distances, weights, speeds, and data sizes.
Instructions:
Install and find Unit Converter on your desktop.
Choose the conversion type and the input/output units, then enter a number.
For example, choose speed, km/h to mph, and enter 100. The converted result appears immediately.

Name: Uptime
Author: Harbor
Description: See how long Windows has been running since the last full restart.
Instructions:
Install to show the time since Windows last completed a full boot.
Read days, hours, minutes, and seconds directly on the desktop.
Drag its header to move it; change Width to give it more room.

Name: Window Desk
Author: Harbor
Description: Open apps, files, notifications, and window layouts from one panel.
Instructions:
Install to add a desktop panel for Apps, Files, notifications, and window layouts.
Click a named control to open that Harbor surface. Choose a layout to organize open app windows.
Use the visual builder to add, remove, or rearrange controls.

Name: Window Layouts
Author: Harbor
Description: Arrange open windows into columns, a grid, or a stack. Undo restores their previous positions.
Instructions:
Install to add window layout buttons to the desktop.
Open a few ordinary app windows, then choose Columns, Grid, or Stack.
Choose Undo to restore their earlier positions. Active games and full-screen windows are skipped.

Name: Window Opacity
Author: Harbor
Description: Make chosen app windows partly transparent so you can see what is behind them. Some apps manage their own transparency.
Instructions:
Install, then put the target executable names in Apps, one per line.
Set Opacity percent: 100 is solid; 70 lets you see through the window. Click Apply settings.
Open a matching app to try it. Some apps manage their own transparency; the live status below explains skipped effects. Pause restores the original opacity.

Excluded apps or titles, one pattern per line

Name: World Clock
Author: Harbor
Description: See the time in another city without changing your PC’s time zone.
Instructions:
Install to add another clock to your desktop; your Windows time zone stays the same.
Set Time zone to a Windows zone name, such as Tokyo Standard Time or Eastern Standard Time.
Choose a time format and click Apply settings. Drag the header to place it beside your local clock.
